entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: Historical and ideological trend of scientific, socio-political, ethno-confessional and cultural life that arose in the north-western region, based on the postulate that belarusians are an ethnographic group of the all-russian people  Originating c. 1720 CE. Western Russianism is a political ideology, arising around 1720. Attributed to Afanasiy Yarushevich.
